ground.$description: The page, and the surfaces that sit on it. Raised is lighter than the ground in the light theme and lighter again in the dark one: menus and the row editor come forward. Well is for things set INTO the page — inputs, bar tracks.

raised.$description: The page, and the surfaces that sit on it. Raised is lighter than the ground in the light theme and lighter again in the dark one: menus and the row editor come forward. Well is for things set INTO the page — inputs, bar tracks.

well.$description: The page, and the surfaces that sit on it. Raised is lighter than the ground in the light theme and lighter again in the dark one: menus and the row editor come forward. Well is for things set INTO the page — inputs, bar tracks.

card.$description: A card: the white sheet a chart or a figure sits on, lifted off the ground by a soft shadow (.card, below).

rule.$description: Hairlines between rows, and the stronger edge of an input or a chip.

rule-strong.$description: Hairlines between rows, and the stronger edge of an input or a chip.

ink.$description: Text. Faint is used at 11-14px for eyebrows and metadata, below the large-text threshold, so all three clear 4.5:1 on the ground, on Raised, on Well and on a card, in both themes.

ink-dim.$description: Text. Faint is used at 11-14px for eyebrows and metadata, below the large-text threshold, so all three clear 4.5:1 on the ground, on Raised, on Well and on a card, in both themes.

ink-faint.$description: Text. Faint is used at 11-14px for eyebrows and metadata, below the large-text threshold, so all three clear 4.5:1 on the ground, on Raised, on Well and on a card, in both themes.

edited.$description: Reserved for human edits. Never use for anything else.

earned.$description: Money earned: income amounts. Not "a positive number" — a card payment is positive on the card and is not earned.

alert.$description: Something a person has to look at: an error, a difference from the bank. Always beside words that say what is wrong.

chart-strong.$description: The chart's two neutral inks: the Flow's sources and buckets, and fixed against variable. A cool slate rather than grey, so money that has not been spent yet reads as calm rather than switched off. At least 3:1 apart and each 3:1 against the ground and a card, so two touching bands read as two.

chart-mid.$description: The chart's two neutral inks: the Flow's sources and buckets, and fixed against variable. A cool slate rather than grey, so money that has not been spent yet reads as calm rather than switched off. At least 3:1 apart and each 3:1 against the ground and a card, so two touching bands read as two.

group-1.$description: The group palette. A category is drawn in its group's slot, everywhere (V10); the slot is the group's position among groups that hold spending. The ORDER is part of the palette: adjacent slots are what the validator passed (normal-vision ΔE ≥ 15, CVD ΔE ≥ 8), so never reorder or insert.
